works.title: Works

outcomes.createdPublished: Added and published to the site.
outcomes.savedDraft: Changes saved. The work is a draft and is not on the site.
outcomes.savedPublished: Changes saved. The work is on the site.
outcomes.markedSold: The work is marked sold and is no longer offered for sale on the site.
outcomes.returnedToSale: The work is back on sale, and its sale channel has been cleared.

works.empty: No works have been added yet.

login.title: Admin login
login.error: That email or password is not correct.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

deleteWork.title: Delete a work
deleteWork.draftWarning: This work is a draft. It has never appeared on the site, and deleting it removes it for good.
deleteWork.publishedWarning: This work is on the site and has a permanent address. The link may already have been sent to someone or be known to Google — deleting it breaks that link for good, and it cannot be undone.
deleteWork.unpublishInstead: If you simply do not want the work on the site, take it off instead. Nothing is deleted, and you can put it back at any time.
deleteWork.cancel: Cancel and go back to editing

outcomes.ordered: A work that sold through the site cannot be deleted — it appears on an order. Take it off the site instead.
outcomes.notFound: That work was not found. It may already have been deleted.
outcomes.unexpected: Something went wrong and the work was not deleted. Try again.

saleState.title: Sale
saleState.markWarning: Where did it sell? The status becomes sold, and the work stops being available to buy on the site.
saleState.returnWarning: The work becomes available again, and the site shows it as such.
saleState.returnClearsChannel: This also clears the sale channel that was recorded, so no available work is left saying where it sold.
saleState.siteSaleWarning: This work sold through the site, which means an order exists for it.
saleState.siteSaleNote: Returning such a work to sale says the money went back — and that is a decision about the order, not about the painting. It cannot be done from here.
saleState.cancel: Cancel and go back to editing

outcomes.notFound: That work was not found. It may already have been deleted.
outcomes.siteSale: A work that sold through the site cannot be changed from here.
outcomes.unknownChannel: Unknown sale channel. Nothing was changed.

preview.title: Preview
preview.draft: This is how the work will look on the site. It is not published yet — nobody but you can see it.
preview.published: This is how the work looks on the site. It is published and visible to everyone.
preview.viewOnSite: Open the page on the site

orders.title: Orders
orders.refundDueBody: Money was taken for a painting that could not be delivered, and the charge was not voided automatically. The refund is not automatic - make it by hand in the Hyp console, then mark it done here.
orders.staleTitle: Orders pending for more than an hour
orders.staleBody: The buyer may have paid and closed the window before returning to the site. There is no way for us to know on our own - check the Hyp console for a matching charge, and contact the buyer if there is one.
orders.dispatchBody: Posted over a week ago and still not marked as received. The 14-day cancellation window is counted from receipt, so until it is marked there is no way to know when the window ends. Check with the buyer that the painting arrived, then mark it on the order page.

order.title: Order
order.pickupNote: Self-pickup, arranged directly with the buyer. An order like this has no delivery address.
order.actionsNone: No actions are available at this stage.
order.releaseNote: Cancelling or refunding returns this order’s paintings to draft and clears their sale channel - they do not go straight back onto the site. Republishing is done from the painting itself.
order.refundDueBanner: Money was taken for a painting that had already sold to someone else, and the charge was not voided. Refund by hand in the Hyp console, then mark it done. The paintings on this order belong to another buyer and will not be released.

outcomes.advanced-shipped: The order is marked as posted.
outcomes.advanced-delivered: The order is marked as received.
outcomes.cancelled: The order is cancelled and its paintings are back to draft.
outcomes.refunded: The refund is recorded and the paintings are back to draft.
outcomes.refundSettled: Recorded that the refund has been made.
outcomes.notAllowed: That action is not possible from the order’s current state.

workForm.priceReducedHint: Optional. Must be below the regular price.
workForm.publishHint: Left unticked the work is saved as a draft: visible here in the admin, not on the site.
workForm.addressHint: Generated from the title. Once published it must not change — links already shared would break.

image.hintPending: Up to {megabytes} MB and {megapixels} megapixels. The photograph is attached to the work when the form is saved.
image.dragHint: You can also drag a photograph here from your computer.
image.dropNow: Release here and the photograph will start uploading.
image.donePending: The photograph is ready, and will be attached when the work is saved.

errors.tooManyPixels: The image is {pixels} megapixels, and the most allowed is {max}. Reduce its dimensions and try once more.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not finish. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.notSignedIn: The session has expired. Sign in again and try once more.
errors.notFound: That work was not found. Refresh the page.
errors.notConfigured: The image service is not configured. Ask whoever maintains the site.
errors.hostUnreachable: The image uploaded, but it could not be saved. Upload it again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong saving the image. Try again.

errors.summary: Could not save. Check the marked fields.
errors.notBelowPrice: The reduced price must be below the regular price.
errors.notADate: That is not a valid date.
errors.unusable: No web address can be made from that title.
errors.duplicateSlug: A work already uses that address. Change the title or the address.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong and the work was not saved. Try again.
errors.notSignedIn: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.slugLocked: A published work's address cannot be changed.
errors.imageRequiredToPublish: A work cannot be published without a photograph — on the site it would appear as an empty frame. Attach one at the top of this page, then tick publish and save.
errors.imageRequiredToPublishNew: A work cannot be published without a photograph — on the site it would appear as an empty frame. Attach one above and save, or save without ticking publish. The work has not been saved yet.
errors.imageNotConfirmed: The photograph uploaded, but it could not be confirmed with the image service — so the work was not saved. Upload it again and save.
errors.notFound: That work was not found. It may have been deleted.

workForm.publishedHint: Unticking takes the work off the site and keeps it as a draft. Nothing is deleted.
workForm.addressLockedHint: This work is published, so its address cannot change. Changing it would break every link already shared and its place in Google.
workForm.saleChannelAutomatic: This work sold through this site. That record is made at checkout and cannot be changed here.
